Prishata.note: King of Panchala; father of Drupada.

people.Drupada: King of Panchala; humiliated by his old classmate Drona, he won from a sacrifice a son to slay Drona and a daughter to wed the Pandavas.
people.Shikhandi: Child of Drupada, the reincarnation of Amba; born a girl and later made a man, whose presence let Bhishma be brought down, for Bhishma would not fight one born a woman.
people.Dhrishtadyumna: Son of Drupada, born from the sacrificial fire; commander of the Pandava army, fated to and did slay Drona.

Draupadi.note: Also Krishnaa and Yajnaseni; born of the sacrificial fire beside Dhrishtadyumna. Won by Arjuna, she became the shared wife of all five Pandavas and empress of Indraprastha.

people.Satyajit: Son of Drupada; a Panchala warrior who died shielding Yudhishthira in the war.
people.Kshatradharma: Son of Dhrishtadyumna, of the Panchala line.
